title: Tiger cub waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='100' height='100'>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d='M72 72 Q86 70 84 58 Q83 52 88 50' stroke='#FF8C00' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M72 72 Q86 70 84 58 Q83 52 88 50' stroke='#3D1F00' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-dasharray='2 5'/>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='22' ry='18' fill='#FF8C00'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='75' rx='13' ry='12' fill='#FFE4B5'/>

  <path d='M31 63 Q36 66 34 70' stroke='#3D1F00' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M69 63 Q64 66 66 70' stroke='#3D1F00' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <ellipse cx='30' cy='76' rx='6' ry='9' fill='#FF8C00' transform='rotate(20 30 76)'/>
  <ellipse cx='29' cy='83' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#FFE4B5'/>

  <circle cx='82' cy='44' r='2' fill='#FF8C00'/>

  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='22' fill='#FF8C00'/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='20' r='8' fill='#FF8C00'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='20' r='4.5' fill='#FFB6C1'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='20' r='8' fill='#FF8C00'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='20' r='4.5' fill='#FFB6C1'/>
  <!-- Face white patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='15' ry='12' fill='#FFE4B5'/>

  <path d='M44 22 Q46 28 44 30' stroke='#3D1F00' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M56 22 Q54 28 56 30' stroke='#3D1F00' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <path d='M29 38 L36 40' stroke='#3D1F00' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M29 44 L36 44' stroke='#3D1F00' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M71 38 L64 40' stroke='#3D1F00' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M71 44 L64 44' stroke='#3D1F00' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='38' r='4' fill='#2E8B57'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='38' r='4' fill='#2E8B57'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='37' r='1.5' fill='white'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='37' r='1.5' fill='white'/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <path d='M47 45 L53 45 L50 49 Z' fill='#FF69B4'/>
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d='M50 49 Q46 53 43 51' stroke='#3D1F00' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 49 Q54 53 57 51' stroke='#3D1F00' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Whiskers -->
  <path d='M34 43 L24 41' stroke='#FFE4B5' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M34 46 L24 47' stroke='#FFE4B5' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M66 43 L76 41' stroke='#FFE4B5' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M66 46 L76 47' stroke='#FFE4B5' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='90' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#FF8C00'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='90' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#FF8C00'/>

  <ellipse cx='62' cy='91' rx='4.5' ry='2.5' fill='#FFE4B5'/>
